notablePrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to a nonlegendary artifact you control.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Stasis and Mechanized Production trigger.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a copy of the artifact it is attached to.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the artifact token, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Repeat during each of your turns.
As long as Stasis is on the battlefield, players skip their untap steps.
